avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May stimulate immune function, counteracting leflunomide's immunosuppressive effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may reduce therapeutic efficacy of leflunomide

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer, may decrease leflunomide active metabolite levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; coordinate with healthcare provider before initiating

avoid_supplements.name: Methotrexate
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both are hepatotoxic DMARDs; combined use increases liver injury risk
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated in combination; do not use together

avoid_supplements.name: Hepatotoxic herbs (Kava, Comfrey, Greater Celandine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive hepatotoxicity risk with leflunomide, which undergoes hepatic metabolism
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; monitor liver function tests closely if exposure occurs

caution_supplements.name: Folic acid/Folinic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce leflunomide efficacy but is commonly co-prescribed to reduce toxicity
caution_supplements.action: Use as directed by prescribing physician; separate dosing by 2-4 hours if possible

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (high-dose >400 IU)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive immunosuppressive effects and increased bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU daily; monitor for bleeding or increased infections

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May stimulate immune function; potential interference with leflunomide immunosuppression
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; inform healthcare provider of concurrent use

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol (chronic/heavy use)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases hepatotoxicity risk; leflunomide and active metabolite are hepatotoxic
avoid_foods.action: Abstain from alcohol or limit to <1 drink/day; monitor liver function tests regularly

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: May alter absorption and metabolism of leflunomide
avoid_foods.action: Take leflunomide consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary patterns

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; may increase leflunomide metabolite levels slightly
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; not strictly contraindicated but inconsistent intake may affect levels

caution_foods.name: High-purine foods (organ meats, certain seafood)
caution_foods.mechanism: Leflunomide inhibits dihydroorotate dehydrogenase; theoretical interaction in urate metabolism
caution_foods.action: No strict restriction needed; maintain balanced diet and monitor uric acid levels if indicated

monitoring_notes: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, albumin) every 4-8 weeks during leflunomide therapy; baseline and periodic CBC, renal function, and blood pressure assessment are essential. Educate patients on teratogenicity risk and the need for cholestyramine washout if discontinuing due to toxicity or pregnancy planning.
